title: Write the repository agent rules
acceptance: States that castiel is abstract-only, that no implementation code may appear anywhere in it, and that implementations fork it and live outside amk/.
Lists the files an agent must read before any task, the ID and immutability rules, the platform/language neutrality rule and the rule never to edit generated *-spec-full.md files.
Defines how design proposals (DP-nn) and open questions are recorded, and that each task is executed on its own branch with its own pull request.
Contains no tooling instructions that depend on a specific platform or language.
